title: Radio-Controlled Off-Road Car 1:16 – Metal Body and Two Batteries
seo_title: Radio-Controlled Off-Road Car 1:16 – Metal Body, Two Batteries
seo_description: Radio-controlled off-road car 1:16 with a metal body and 2.4 GHz radio. Two 3.7 V batteries give up to 50 min of driving according to the supplier.
descriptionHtml:
The second before the wheels meet the gravel

An ordinary plastic radio-controlled car rarely survives the first real hit against a rock or curb – the body cracks, and the battery then runs out after a short while before you've even had a proper drive.

A metal alloy body, with two batteries in the box

The car is built in 1:16 scale with a metal alloy body and 2WD according to the box, and is controlled on 2.4 GHz at up to 20 km/h. Two 3.7 V batteries are included, and according to the supplier they last up to 50 minutes of driving together.

Features

  • Handles tougher terrain – metal alloy body instead of plastic.
  • Lasts a whole playtime – two 3.7 V batteries together give up to 50 minutes of driving according to the supplier.
  • Doesn't interfere when several people drive at once – the remote uses 2.4 GHz.
  • Gets up to real speed outdoors – top speed 20 km/h.
  • You choose the color you like best – available in blue, black and orange.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
